evaluated: 55 original fixed regions x 3 variants; 165 audited runs; plus one newly annotated training scene x 5 regions x 3 unchanged methods = 15 audited runs.
interpretation: Perspective camera constraints improve the hidden-road coverage/error tradeoff on these repeatedly used development roads. Footprint candidate coverage falls. Errors remain substantial and no under-car truth or independent test-group evaluation exists.
gps_ablation: Weak GPS/yaw/height priors add no clear benefit over the free metric-plane fit. Do not tune these priors further before improving correspondence evidence.
hard_road_results: Gironde and Alsace still abstain, including eleven-frame windows. The fresh Bourges unmarked-turn training case also fully abstains: every image pair has only 0-2 accepted learned matches, no graph edge.
next: Prioritize low-texture matching and appropriate contextual pose observations. Another geometry-only optimization cannot connect a target with no observed correspondences. Keep all old outputs and the new failure.
new_annotation: benchmark_v3/annotations_train_001.json; visually reviewed per-frame masks frozen before any scoring; proxy masks span 49.0% and 75.4% of ego area, not full-occlusion ground truth.
